sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO EAI.IF_SEM_PO_DETAIL A USING ( SELECT #BUKRS# AS BUKRS, #EBELN# AS EBELN, #EBELP# AS EBELP FROM DUAL ) B ON ( 1 = 1 AND B.BUKRS = A.BUKRS AND B.EBELN = A.EBELN AND B.EBELP = A.EBELP ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET LOEKZ_ITEM = #LOEKZ_ITEM#, MATNR = #MATNR#, TXZ01 = #TXZ01#, SPEC = #SPEC#, MENGE = #MENGE#, MEINS = #MEINS#, NETPR = #NETPR#, WAERS = #WAERS#, AMT = #AMT#, EINDT = #EINDT#, POSTAL = #POSTAL#, ADDRESS1 = #ADDRESS1#, ADDRESS2 = #ADDRESS2#, PO_DATE = #PO_DATE#, PO_TIME = #PO_TIME#, ORDER_FLAG = #ORDER_FLAG#, GR_ID = #GR_ID#, GR_NAME = #GR_NAME#, GR_TELNO = #GR_TELNO#, GR_HPNO = #GR_HPNO#, G_CODE = #G_CODE#, G_NAME = #G_NAME#, U_CODE = #U_CODE#, P_CODE = #P_CODE#, ID = #ID#, ORDER_STEP = #ORDER_STEP#, GUBUN = #GUBUN#, QUALITY_CLASS = #QUALITY_CLASS#, PEINH = #PEINH#, IF_FLAG = 'N' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BUKRS, EBELN, EBELP, LOEKZ_ITEM, MATNR, TXZ01, SPEC, MENGE, MEINS, NETPR, WAERS, AMT, EINDT, POSTAL, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, PO_DATE, PO_TIME, ORDER_FLAG, GR_ID, GR_NAME, GR_TELNO, GR_HPNO, G_CODE, G_NAME, U_CODE, P_CODE, ID, ORDER_STEP, GUBUN, PEINH, QUALITY_CLASS, IF_FLAG ) VALUES ( #BUKRS#, #EBELN#, #EBELP#, #LOEKZ_ITEM#, #MATNR#, #TXZ01#, #SPEC#, #MENGE#, #MEINS#, #NETPR#, #WAERS#, #AMT#, #EINDT#, #POSTAL#, #ADDRESS1#, #ADDRESS2#, #PO_DATE#, #PO_TIME#, #ORDER_FLAG#, #GR_ID#, #GR_NAME#, #GR_TELNO#, #GR_HPNO#, #G_CODE#, #G_NAME#, #U_CODE#, #P_CODE#, #ID#, #ORDER_STEP#, #GUBUN#, #PEINH#, #QUALITY_CLASS#, 'N' )

MERGE INTO EAI.IF_SEM_PO_MASTER A USING ( SELECT #BUKRS# AS BUKRS, #EBELN# AS EBELN FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUKRS = A.BUKRS AND B.EBELN = A.EBELN ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET LOEKZ = #LOEKZ#, REQ_SYSTEM = #REQ_SYSTEM#, WERKS = #WERKS#, GSBER = #GSBER#, KOSTL = #KOSTL#, LTEXT = #LTEXT#, BEDAT = #BEDAT#, ERNAM = #ERNAM#, ERNAM_NM = #ERNAM_NM#, ERNAM_TEL = #ERNAM_TEL#, PURCHASER_NAME = #PURCHASER_NAME#, PURCHASER_TEL = #PURCHASER_TEL#, ORIGIN_CODE = #ORIGIN_CODE# WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( LOEKZ, REQ_SYSTEM, BUKRS, WERKS, GSBER, KOSTL, LTEXT, EBELN, BEDAT, ERNAM, ERNAM_NM, ERNAM_TEL, PURCHASER_NAME, PURCHASER_TEL, ORIGIN_CODE ) VALUES ( #LOEKZ#, #REQ_SYSTEM#, #BUKRS#, #WERKS#, #GSBER#, #KOSTL#, #LTEXT#, #EBELN#, #BEDAT#, #ERNAM#, #ERNAM_NM#, #ERNAM_TEL#, #PURCHASER_NAME#, #PURCHASER_TEL#, #ORIGIN_CODE# )
